cooked: BIP 448 helpfully compares itself to BIP 346 (OP_TXHASH) and BIP 119 (CHECKTEMPLATEVERIFY), but not to BIP 118 (SIGHASH_ANYPREVOUT). What’s the diff of applications enabled by 448 and 118? According to the discussion in the LNHANCE thread, the main drawback of APO is that it’s too specific to covenants, is this right?
